blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Even out the dynamics of arpeggios and add slight punch.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, clean Fender tone required for arpeggios.
Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the US Deluxe amp.

blocks.purpose: Add spacious 'light delay' and rhythmic echo.
